name: Aircall
description: Cloud phone system / call center platform with a public REST API covering calls, contacts, users, numbers, messaging and conversation intelligence.
access_notes: Aircall customers self-serve API keys (api_id + api_token, used as HTTP Basic credentials) from Dashboard > Integrations > API keys; API access is bundled with paid plans (Essentials $30/user/mo, 3-user minimum, lists 'API access'). OAuth is reserved for approved Technology Partners building marketplace apps and requires manual onboarding via marketplace@aircall.io — no self-serve OAuth client registration.
mcp_notes: No official Aircall-vendor MCP server (Aircall's docs only give best practices for building MCP servers that its AIVA agent can call). Pipedream hosts an Aircall MCP server (mcp.pipedream.com/app/aircall); community servers exist (e.g. themobilefirstco/aircall-mcp-server, 73 tools, explicitly unofficial). No Aircall toolkit found in the Composio toolkits catalog.
uncertainty_notes: Whether API keys can be generated during a free trial is not documented; Aircall does not publish which plan tiers gate specific API features or rate-limit thresholds. Multi-customer (OAuth) integrations are partner_gated even though own-account Basic Auth is self-serve. MCP searches tried: 'Aircall MCP server official', Composio catalog grep.

evidence.note: 'Aircall supports two ways to authenticate with the REST API: Basic Authentication and OAuth'; OAuth for public integrations by approved tech partners.
Generate API ID + token from Aircall Dashboard; Base64 api_id:api_token in Authorization header; requires an Aircall (customer) account.
REST API at api.aircall.io/v1 covering calls, contacts, users, teams, numbers, messages, webhooks; OAuth client_id/secret obtained by contacting Aircall.
Aircall help: OAuth for marketplace/partner apps, Basic Auth for customers building for their own account; webhooks available for real-time events.
